summary: The state is sealed to 4 readers. Attributes, outputs and stored plans are encrypted. Addresses, types, names, dependencies and revisions stay readable, so the graph and the plans keep working.

file.text: The readers file and the store differ: dan is in the file and not in the store; fay and x; rm -rf ~ are in the store and not in the file. Writers refuse to write until they match.

recovery.text: No recovery recipient. If every reader loses their key, the state cannot be read.

last_change.text: Last change: readers rewrapped by ada on 2026-10-22 10:41 UTC (eve added).

suggestions.title: Make the store match the readers file
suggestions.why: The file and the store list different readers. Writers refuse to write until they match.

suggestions.why: Removing the line stops new records being sealed to ada. ada keeps what they already read, and an old copy of the bucket still opens with their key. Replace the real secrets ada could read where they live.

suggestions.title: Seal every record again
suggestions.why: Records stay under an old group until they are written again.

suggestions.title: Drop the groups nothing is sealed in
suggestions.why: A reader who was removed keeps the data key of the groups they were in. A group that no record, output or stored plan is sealed in is dropped from meta.json, and the key opens nothing that is left. The same command deletes the records that no pointer names once they are a day old.
